verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents its own Deployments feature, a containers-as-a-service offering for running container images and serving ML models. That is a managed alternative to running VMs yourself. However, nothing in the evidence shows autoscaling GPU workers, scale-to-zero, or serverless per-request billing. Machine auto-shutdown only stops an idle VM and is not serverless scaling, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented autoscaling of workers, scale-to-zero behavior, serverless billing/cold-start details, and any hands-on corroboration of Deployments.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy code to autoscaling serverless GPU workers that scale to zero, instead of managing always-on instances

citations.quote: Deployments are containers-as-a-service that let you run container images and serve machine learning models.
